randomized_domain.draw: one random.Random(master_seed * 100 + k) per entry point k (k = 0 rk, 1 line_mev_value, 2 system_margin, 3 harness_row60, 4 closure_state, 5 _unresolved, 6 rollup, 7 system_margin_bid, 8 assert_no_margin_relaxation, 9 assert_bid_margin_reading). Masses: 70 % log-uniform 1e-6..1e3 kg, 20 % uniform 0..60 kg rounded to 0..12 decimals, 10 % specials (0.0, -0.0, an int 0..40, an exact .5 tie 1e9..1e10, 5e-324); invalid values (negative, nan, inf, bool, str, None where a number is required) with probability 0.03 per argument; fractions / reserves the registered value with probability 0.9, else one of E-K03; closure_state: 20 % known == reference; _unresolved: random line records (id AL-01..AL-10 / AL-HAR; value_kg None or a mass; governs ALLOCATION_MEV / MEV_PLANNING_FLOOR / MEV_FROM_CBE / None; allocation_status present or absent; floor_is_partial absent / true / false; 1-4 floor constituents with kg None or a mass); rollup: an ordered random subset (0..10) of AL-01..AL-10 with random line records plus one AL-HAR line at a random position, 1-4 distinct Xe cases (0.5..20 kg, 0..4 decimals; loaded == case with probability 0.97, residual 0..0.5 kg), 1-3 references from (HARD_40_WET, 40.0, <), (INTERNAL_34, 34.0, <=), (INTERNAL_36, 36.0, <=) and random (R-n, 0..80 kg, strict random); readings: the owner reading with 0-2 random key mutations

exact_invariants.statement: determinism: the Rust call list evaluated twice in one process gives identical output; the Python call list evaluated twice gives identical output

roll-up arithmetic on every returned rollup (both): nonharness_known_kg == rk(sum of the known non-harness parts in line order), harness_kg == rk(nonharness_known_kg x 0.05 / 0.95), nominal_dry_known_kg == rk(nonharness_known_kg + harness_kg), dry_known_kg == rk(nominal x 1.2), system_margin_kg == rk(0.2 x nominal); for system_margin_bid total_kg == rk(pre x 1.1): dry = non-harness x (1 / 0.95) x line factors x system margin, the line factors being inside the MEV line values (line_mev_value: MEV floor = rk(floor x 1.20))

no PASS: every returned closure state is CLOSES / DOES_NOT_CLOSE / NOT_EVALUABLE, every rollup has all_terms_resolved false and a HARD_40_WET row is never CLOSES in a rollup (closure_state is called with all_resolved False)
margin readings: system_margin admits only fraction 0.20, system_margin_bid only 0.10, harness_row60 only 0.05, line_mev_value only equipment margin 0.20; reserve only 0 (E-K03) - in both
